fields.ic_name: AMBA AXI / ACE Protocol Specification (ARM IHI 0022E)
fields.rationale: ACE is not an opcode/byte-oriented command protocol. It extends AXI4 with coherency-specific multi-bit fields on the AR/AW channels and adds three new snoop channels (AC/CR/CD). 'Commands' are encoded as (AxBAR, AxDOMAIN, AxSNOOP) field tuples that select a coherent transaction type.

ace_acknowledge_signals.RACK: Master -> Interconnect; 1 cycle after RLAST+RVALID+RREADY at rising ACLK; confirms read response accepted.
ace_acknowledge_signals.WACK: Master -> Interconnect; 1 cycle after BVALID+BREADY at rising ACLK; confirms write response accepted.

AxDOMAIN_encoding.0b00: Non-shareable — single master domain, no snoop required
AxDOMAIN_encoding.0b10: Outer Shareable — Outer shareability domain (superset of Inner)
AxDOMAIN_encoding.0b11: System — all masters in the system; not cacheable

ARSNOOP_coherent_read_encodings.0b0001: ReadShared — request a shareable copy; line may be returned as Shared or Unique
ARSNOOP_coherent_read_encodings.0b0010: ReadClean — request a clean copy; PassDirty must be 0
ARSNOOP_coherent_read_encodings.0b0011: ReadNotSharedDirty — receiver does not support SharedDirty
ARSNOOP_coherent_read_encodings.0b0111: ReadUnique — request exclusive ownership; invalidates other caches
ARSNOOP_coherent_read_encodings.0b1000: CleanShared — cache-maintenance, retain Shared copies, write back dirty
ARSNOOP_coherent_read_encodings.0b1001: CleanInvalid — cache-maintenance, invalidate all, write back dirty
ARSNOOP_coherent_read_encodings.0b1011: CleanUnique — clean local + invalidate others (no data transferred to master)
ARSNOOP_coherent_read_encodings.0b1100: MakeUnique — invalidate other copies without returning data (used before full-line overwrite)
ARSNOOP_coherent_read_encodings.0b1101: MakeInvalid — invalidate without writing back (content discarded)
ARSNOOP_coherent_read_encodings.0b1110: DVM Complete — completion notification of a DVM message sequence
ARSNOOP_coherent_read_encodings.0b1111: DVM Message — distributed virtual memory message (TLB inv / BP inv / IC inv / VA sync)

AWSNOOP_coherent_write_encodings.0b000_Shareable: WriteUnique — partial line write, ensures uniqueness before write
AWSNOOP_coherent_write_encodings.0b001: WriteLineUnique — full cache-line write, ensures uniqueness
AWSNOOP_coherent_write_encodings.0b010: WriteClean — write back a dirty line and retain a Clean copy
AWSNOOP_coherent_write_encodings.0b011: WriteBack — write back a dirty line and invalidate locally
AWSNOOP_coherent_write_encodings.0b100: Evict — notify interconnect of cache-line removal (no data transferred)
AWSNOOP_coherent_write_encodings.0b101: WriteEvict — optional, requires AWUNIQUE signal, writes back UniqueClean lines

RRESP_extension.RRESP[1:0]: Inherited AXI: 00 OKAY, 01 EXOKAY, 10 SLVERR, 11 DECERR
RRESP_extension.RRESP[2]: PassDirty — 1 = cache line is dirty wrt memory, initiating master must ensure write-back
RRESP_extension.RRESP[3]: IsShared — 1 = another cache may hold a copy, line must be held in Shared state

RRESP_combined_meaning.0b0000: Clean Unique data — line not dirty, no other copy
RRESP_combined_meaning.0b0100: Pass dirty Unique — line dirty, no other copy (receiver responsible for WB)
RRESP_combined_meaning.0b1000: Shared Clean — line not dirty, may be shared
RRESP_combined_meaning.0b1100: Shared Dirty — line dirty AND may be shared (receiver responsible)

BRESP_extension.BRESP[1:0]: Inherited AXI: 00 OKAY, 01 EXOKAY, 10 SLVERR, 11 DECERR
BRESP_extension.BRESP[2]: DataTransfer — used in WriteUnique/WriteLineUnique pass-dirty completion

CRRESP_snoop_response_encoding.CRRESP[0]: DataTransfer — 1 = full cache line of data will be provided on CD
CRRESP_snoop_response_encoding.CRRESP[2]: PassDirty — 1 = cache line was dirty, responsibility transferred (cache line moves Clean or Invalid)
CRRESP_snoop_response_encoding.CRRESP[3]: IsShared — 1 = snooped cache retains a copy after snoop
CRRESP_snoop_response_encoding.CRRESP[4]: WasUnique — 1 = cache line was Unique before this snoop

fields.ACSNOOP_encoding: Same encoding as ARSNOOP for the corresponding snoop type (e.g., 0b0001 ReadShared maps to ReadShared snoop, 0b1100 MakeUnique maps to MakeUnique snoop, etc.). The interconnect uses ACSNOOP to tell the cached master what kind of action to take.
valid_ready_handshake_rules_ace: All AXI + ACE channels use VALID/READY handshake.
VALID must not depend combinationally on READY (deadlock prevention).
On AC channel: interconnect drives ACVALID/ACADDR/ACSNOOP/ACPROT; cached master drives ACREADY.
On CR channel: cached master drives CRVALID/CRRESP; interconnect drives CRREADY.
On CD channel: cached master drives CDVALID/CDDATA/CDLAST; interconnect drives CDREADY.
Snoop channel dependency rule: master must wait for both ACVALID and ACREADY before asserting CRVALID or CDVALID.

ReadShared_to_shared_clean_line: Interconnect issues snoops on AC channel to other coherent masters (ACSNOOP=ReadShared).
Other masters respond on CR with CRRESP IsShared/PassDirty as appropriate; CD provides data if cache hit.
Interconnect returns data on R channel with RRESP[3:2] = IsShared/PassDirty matching cluster state.
Line installed in M0 cache as SharedClean (or SharedDirty / UniqueClean / UniqueDirty per RRESP).
ReadUnique_invalidate_others: Master M0 wants exclusive copy: issues ReadUnique.
Interconnect snoops other caches with ACSNOOP=ReadUnique.
Snooped caches invalidate their copy; IsShared in CRRESP must be 0.
If a snooped cache had dirty line, it returns CRRESP with PassDirty=1, DataTransfer=1, and dirty line on CD.
Interconnect returns line to M0 with RRESP[3]=0 (not shared); M0 installs as UniqueClean or UniqueDirty per RRESP[2].
MakeUnique_before_full_line_write: Master plans to overwrite a full cache line — issues MakeUnique (ARSNOOP=0b1100).
Interconnect snoops other caches with ACSNOOP=MakeUnique.
Snooped caches invalidate without returning data.
Interconnect returns single transfer with RDATA ignored, RLAST=1.
M0 issues RACK; then writes the new line via WriteBack/WriteClean.
CleanInvalid_cache_maintenance: Master issues CleanInvalid (ARSNOOP=0b1001) — used by software to flush+invalidate.
Snooped dirty caches must write back via CD; clean caches optionally write back.
All snooped caches transition to Invalid; CRRESP IsShared=0.
Single RDATA transfer (ignored); RLAST=1; M0 issues RACK.
WriteBack_evict_dirty_line: Cached master decides to evict a UniqueDirty/SharedDirty line.
Master sends W data over W channel.
Slave returns BRESP OKAY; master issues WACK; line removed from cache.
DVM_TLB_invalidate: Initiator master issues DVMMessage (ARSNOOP=0b1111) with TLB-invalidate payload encoded in ARADDR/ARLEN/ARPROT.
Interconnect distributes DVM message via AC channel to all targeted masters.
Each target master invalidates the relevant TLB entries and acknowledges via CRRESP.
Initiator issues a follow-up DVMComplete (ARSNOOP=0b1110) once all targets have responded.

ace_lite_subset_constraints: ACE-Lite master has no AC/CR/CD channels (does not own a snoop-able cache).
ACE-Lite master can issue ReadOnce/ReadNoSnoop and WriteUnique/WriteLineUnique/WriteNoSnoop only.
ACE-Lite master observes RRESP[3:2] but never sets IsShared/PassDirty (since it has no cache).
Typical ACE-Lite users: DMA controllers, GPUs, IO bridges that need coherent visibility to shared data without participating in snoop protocol.

evidence.quote: AxDOMAIN[1:0]: 0b00 Non-shareable, 0b01 Inner Shareable, 0b10 Outer Shareable, 0b11 System.
AxBAR encodes barrier transactions on AR and AW channels: AxBAR[0]=1 indicates a barrier; AxBAR[1] encodes barrier type.

ARSNOOP encodings: 0b0000 ReadNoSnoop/ReadOnce, 0b0001 ReadShared, 0b0010 ReadClean, 0b0011 ReadNotSharedDirty, 0b0111 ReadUnique, 0b1011 CleanUnique, 0b1100 MakeUnique, 0b1000 CleanShared, 0b1001 CleanInvalid, 0b1101 MakeInvalid, 0b1110 DVM Complete, 0b1111 DVM Message.
AWSNOOP encodings: 0b000 WriteNoSnoop/WriteUnique, 0b001 WriteLineUnique, 0b010 WriteClean, 0b011 WriteBack, 0b100 Evict, 0b101 WriteEvict, 0b000 Barrier.
RRESP[2] PassDirty bit; RRESP[3] IsShared bit. Constant for all data transfers within a burst.
CRRESP[4:0]: [0] DataTransfer, [1] Error, [2] PassDirty, [3] IsShared, [4] WasUnique.
The snoop data bus, CDDATA, is not required to be the same width as the read data and write data buses.
The master must wait for both ACVALID and ACREADY to be asserted before asserting CRVALID. The master must wait for both ACVALID and ACREADY to be asserted before asserting CDVALID.
